items.title: The derived category of torsion abelian sheaves is the full subcategory of complexes with torsion cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the derived category of the Serre subcategory of torsion abelian sheaves with the complexes on the site whose cohomology sheaves are torsion (statement lines 4217-4223). The proof is a complete chain of homological algebra: injective abelian sheaves are shown to be divisible (proof lines 4226-4232); a comparison of the torsion subcomplex of a complex of injective sheaves with torsion cohomology with the complex itself is proved to be a quasi-isomorphism using flatness of the rationals and divisibility (proof lines 4233-4264); and the homotopy classes of maps into the torsion subcomplex are identified so that it is K-injective, after which the adjoint criterion gives the equivalence (proof lines 4265-4278). The non-formal content is the identification of the derived categories. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each algebraic input named.
